summary: Implemented/deployed logical-vs-physical HiDPI swapchain candidate after user clarified flicker alternates whole menu-inclusive and hangar-only frames. DXGI `desc_` now remains logical; only physical `backbuffer_desc_` is Retina-scaled and drives Metal presentation/MetalFX, while fullscreen mode requests physical backbuffer dimensions. This avoids leaking physical dimensions through logical ResizeBuffers/GetDesc source paths.
